We start with the name of Allah. He is full of kindness to everyone. He is extra kind to people who believe.
All thanks and praise belong to Allah. He made everything and takes care of it.
Allah is full of kindness. We say it again so we remember.
Allah is the King of the Day of Judgment. That is the Day when everyone gets what they earned.
Allah, we worship only You. We ask only You for help.
We ask Allah to show us the straight path. This is the right way to live.
The straight path is the way of people Allah gave good things to, like the prophets. It is not the way of people who made Allah angry. It is not the way of people who got lost.
